src/astrarun/interaction/service.py.role: High-level workstation capabilities for UI interaction, element resolution, and capability dispatch.
src/astrarun/interaction/service.py.flaw_identified: type_literal_text silently reported success without verifying editor buffer state, and relied on foreground-dependent SendInput/keybd_event even when headless/background execution had GetForegroundWindow() == 0.
src/astrarun/interaction/service.py.remediation: Prioritize UIA ValuePattern IPC directly into editable control buffer; fallback to focused paste; verify postcondition via TextPattern or ValuePattern; return failure if editor buffer remains empty.

src/astrarun/interaction/controller.py.role: Semantic UI control mutation controller using COM IUIAutomation patterns.
src/astrarun/interaction/controller.py.flaw_identified: _get_com_element relied on rigid compound property conditions that occasionally failed on dynamic WinUI 3 / XAML wrapper elements; fallback typing in set_element_value lacked postcondition verification.
src/astrarun/interaction/controller.py.remediation: Strengthen element matching with robust control type fallbacks; ensure ValuePattern and TextPattern query interfaces handle varied COM implementations gracefully.

src/astrarun/interaction/document.py.role: Application document lifecycle and native file saving capabilities.
src/astrarun/interaction/document.py.flaw_identified: save_document_via_ui relied exclusively on legacy Win32 EnumChildWindows searching for 'Edit' and 'Button' classes (which fail in modern DirectUIHWND/IFileDialog Common Item Dialogs), relied on Alt+N/Alt+S keyboard accelerators requiring active foreground focus, and verified destination file existence without checking file_size > 0.
src/astrarun/interaction/document.py.remediation: Upgrade Save As dialog interaction to native UIA COM tree: locate File Name Edit control via UIA ValuePattern; set full path directly; invoke Save button via UIA InvokePattern; handle confirmation dialogs via UIA/Win32; verify physical file exists AND file_size > 0.

src/astrarun/interaction/keyboard.py.role: Win32 keyboard simulation, shortcut parsing, and SendInput/keybd_event dispatch.
src/astrarun/interaction/keyboard.py.notes: Retained for non-UIA legacy desktop controls, game windows, and global hotkeys, but demoted from primary input path for editable text controls.

src/astrarun/interaction/clipboard.py.role: Win32 clipboard manipulation for atomic text transfer.
src/astrarun/interaction/clipboard.py.notes: Useful secondary transport when UIA ValuePattern is unsupported (e.g. Scintilla/Notepad++).

src/astrarun/interaction/discovery.py.role: UI Automation element tree enumeration and bounding box discovery.
src/astrarun/interaction/discovery.py.notes: Core perception engine for window UI controls.

src/astrarun/interaction/resolver.py.role: Semantic fuzzy matching and scoring for UI controls.
src/astrarun/interaction/resolver.py.notes: Matches target natural language query against discovered control names, automation IDs, and types.

src/astrarun/computer_use/ui/dialogs.py.role: Secondary dialog detector from computer_use package.
src/astrarun/computer_use/ui/dialogs.py.notes: Overlaps with interaction/document.py dialog discovery. Should be consolidated into interaction package in subsequent cleanup.

src/astrarun/computer_use/hooks/desktop_.notes: Duplicate of windows/discovery.py::_ensure_desktop_attached. Consolidate to single source of truth.

step_1_launch.verification: Process ID verified alive and window HWND discovered in OS window manager.

step_2_text_entry.mechanism_1_primary: UIA ValuePattern.SetValue on discovered editable control (works without foreground focus).
step_2_text_entry.mechanism_2_fallback: Win32 control message (EM_REPLACESEL / WM_SETTEXT) or window focus + clipboard paste (Ctrl+V).
step_2_text_entry.mandatory_verification: Check UIA TextPattern / ValuePattern or window title dirty state. FAIL if control text is empty.

step_3_save_document.trigger: UIA File -> Save as menu item invoke, with keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+S / Ctrl+S) fallback.
step_3_save_document.dialog_discovery: Locate Save As / Save window via Win32 EnumWindows + UIA Dialog detection.
step_3_save_document.path_entry: Locate File name Edit control in dialog via UIA and apply ValuePattern.SetValue(dest_path).
step_3_save_document.commit: Invoke Save button via UIA InvokePattern or BM_CLICK.
step_3_save_document.confirmation: Detect and accept overwrite confirmation if present.
step_3_save_document.mandatory_verification: Verify physical file exists on disk AND os.path.getsize(dest_path) > 0.
